reviews.title: Replacement for a Corsair CX430M
reviews.comment:
Though modular and of higher wattage than the Corsair, which had a fan failure after 6 years of media centre use, I find this slightly noisier.
Energy efficiency rating is 80 plus bronze, same as the old unit
Installation was a bit tricky, but this was a function of the case design, not the power supply.
Otherwise it does the job with no problems
reviews.author: Amazon Customer

reviews.title: Reliable and quiet
reviews.comment: Great performance and value, overall. I like my power supplies to be fully modular, so I purchased this one because the price was right at the time. Has plenty of power to keep my computer up and running. The fan is very quiet, which is always a plus. No problems at all so far. Highly recommended.
reviews.author: HiroNotHero
